title: Page 8
content_zh:
费郑氏心疼又爱怜地看着女儿，她多么希望原治之能成为一个深情且坚守如一的好女婿啊。

就在这时，小丫鬟隔着门帘轻声禀报：「夫人，原公子求见。」

费郑氏怔了一下，转头看了看女儿沉睡中略带疲惫与忧伤的脸，不由得笑起来，轻轻点了点女儿的额头，笑道：「他倒来得快，看来是真正在乎你的。我的傻闺女，你还是有点傻福气的。」

原治之在堂屋向费郑氏跪拜行了大礼。

费郑氏一如既往，神色淡淡的。让他起身便道：「你能来，就证明了你的心意，有这份心就好。」

原治之垂首恭听，他和费明兰一样，都后知后觉地意识到这位平素看似柔弱无依的妇人，或许有着比谁都明净的一双眼，看得清楚所有的世事人情和虚伪假面。

这样一想，原治之就有点儿害怕，同时庆幸自己赶来请罪真是来对了，如果再晚来一步，得罪了自己这位真正深藏不露的丈母娘，搞不好到手的娘子都要飞走了。

现在原治之才惊觉，面对费郑氏，他居然比面对皇帝玄昱的压力还大。

随即他就恍悟了，费忠贵那么能干有才的一个大商人，怎么会全心全意迷恋一个真正柔弱无能的花瓶美人呢？费郑氏必然是有莫独特魅力，才能计他多年如一日地爱着她、护着她。

希望自家娘子不要像丈母娘这样深藏不露才好呀。

原治之暗暗擦了擦冷汗。

费郑氏微笑着瞥了他一眼，道：「兰儿在里面，你且去看看她吧。」

反正有她这位岳母大人在外间坐镇，也不怕这对小儿女有什么苟且，何况他们都是那么懂事的好孩子呢。

原治之并没有急着进入内室，反而向着费郑氏郑重道：「容香的事，实非得己，但小婿会尽快处理好的，必不会妻负了令嫒，更不会让她伤心难过的。」

费郑氏随意点了点头。

这种事，发再狠的誓言，说再漂亮的好话也没用，拿出行动来才比什么都强。

当年，悔是直到费忠贵把小妾远嫁了，费郑氏心头的刺才勉强摘去。否则任凭那刺在眼前晃荡，就算再豁达的女人也免不了心火旺盛，脾气暴躁。

原治之撩起帘子，齿履轻轻地走进内室。

已是午后，外面又有些阴天，光线略显得暗淡，但是却更加衬托出费明兰清秀中略显苍白的睡颜。

她侧身躺在绣榻上，一只手放在脸侧，一只手却按在了心口，似乎那里正隐隐难受，而莹白如玉的秀美脸蛋上，泪痕尚未干。

原治之的脚步一顿，心如针刺。

这一刻，他恨死了皇权的专制与霸道，皇族之人就可以随意践踏戏弄别人的感情了吗？他们轻飘飘一句话，就能让普通百姓陷于水火之中。

皇家之人，可以共宏图霸业不可共琐碎平生。

待到天下一统，还是早早抽身而退吧！与他的娘子一起做个简单的地主富家翁和富家婆，守着几亩兰花草，或许会活得更轻松快活吧？

原治之静静走到绣榻前，坐到了榻前的绣凳上，轻轻握住了费明兰放在心口的那只手，转而放到了自己心口。

他静静地凝视着费明兰的睡颜，看着她如名兰一般清秀的容颜，觉得原本浮躁难安的心，奇迹般她平静了下来。

他想，他的后半生有如此一位够让他静心的女子相伴，会很幸福吧？

自从发现自己的身世，明白了自己是庶子之后，他内心的挣扎与痛苦就一直没有停止过。

他不以自己是庶子出身而自卑，但是他为隐藏在「庶子」二字背后的恩怨纠缠而烦躁。

太夫人理直气壮，原郑氏委屈怨愤，原北顾茫然无措，他们各有各的立场，可是造成如今情势的，不就是他们吗？

当年只要有一个人立场坚定，手段果断老辣，提早处置好了待妾与庶子的问题，处置好与后宫太后的问题，又哪里会出现如今的局面？哪怕他会因此而不出生，见不到这个万分精采，但也同样残酷的世界，又有什么关系呢？

嫡妻侍妾，嫡子庶子，并非字面上的尊贵卑贱之别，还有更深意义上的各种利益争夺与纠缠，这才是他厌烦的。

再善良的人，再美好的人，一旦出现愤怒与仇恨等种种负面情绪，也会渐渐变得面目丑陋吧？再深的感情也会变得面目全非吧？

当年他父亲爱过嫡妻郑氏吗？爱过他的生母荷音吗？就算他都爱过，可他又真正珍惜了谁？爱护了谁？

原治之对嫡母其实是存了感恩之心的，对三个嫡出兄弟也有手足之情，对小四原平之更是发自内心的疼爱，虽然他迫于各种形式离开了原府，但他心里并不会疏远了他们，而且他日后也会用自己的方式孝顺父母长辈，友爱兄弟手足。

他只是厌倦了大宅门早的那种种阴私之事。

就算现在，父亲的几个待妾依然时不时地会给嫡母找点麻烦与不快吧？

俗话说三个女人一台戏，内宅里的女人一多，再好的家教也不管用，总会生出各种是非。

这样的大宅门，让他不耐烦，也让他郁闷不堪。

原夫人郑氏说的不错，他想挣脱那个豪华的牢笼，他想展翅翱翔蓝天，他要过自己，想过的生活。

他发誓，自己宁愿不要儿子，宁愿绝嗣，也不会生见鬼的庶子！

「兰儿，日后为了咱们九泉之下能得到一碗供饭吃，你以后可要努力多生几个儿子呀。」他把费明兰的手举到自己，嘴边，亲了亲，喃喃低语。

第10章(1)

九月初九，重阳佳节，景国皇后薛珍诞下皇帝玄昱的嫡长子。

玄昱当时正在御书房里和原治之讨论着事情，听到太监来报喜讯时，眉头皱了一下，嘴角虽然上扬，笑意却未见眼底。

他用手指敲了敲龙案，同道：「孩子状况如何？」

报喜太监也没有应有的喜悦，反而胆战心惊地磕头道：「奴婢远远看了一眼，皇子殿下有些瘦小，哭声也弱，但稳破和太医都说除了有点先天体弱，其余一切都好，慢慢调养就会健康无恙。」

玄昱「嗯」了一声。

【本段不纯洁的描写已删减，万分抱歉】

他觉得自己真的很倒楣，为什么几个月在外奔波，为了军资四处联络富商，好不容易回宫述职一回，就偏偏遇到这种「借腹生子」的事发当场。

当初皇宫内传出乐阳公主出家，恰巧薛皇后又发现怀孕二月有余时，原治之就已经明白了玄昱的安排——他要将乐阳所生的孽子变成皇后的嫡子！

原治之为可怜的薛皇后感到悲哀，汉可是她名义上的头生子，如若是个女儿还好说，如若是个儿子，那就是景国皇室名正言顺的嫡长子，是将来最有可能被立为太子继承大业的人选。

那以后若薛皇后真下生了儿子怎么办？最起码在名分上就落了后，吃了亏。

【本段不纯洁的描写已删减，万分抱歉】

这太荒谬了！

玄昱虽然一向喜好美色，却从来不会为美色误国，这次是怎么回事？

可是很快，又来了一名报信太监，汉名小太监更加惶恐，脸色苍白如纸，跪地磕头道：「陛下，元真殿下……甍了。」

原治之的眉毛极快地跳动了一下，然后他立朗垂下眼，继续当木头人。

玄昱「晤」了一声，坐在龙椅上一动也不动。

久久之后，他才几不可闻地叹息一声，低喃：「诸行无常，有生必有死，生死轮回而己。既然她生前就已经出家避世，就按照公主仪制悄悄葬了吧，不必惊动外人。」
content_en:
Mrs. Fei Zheng looked at her daughter with distress and affection. How she hoped that Yuan Zhizhi could become an affectionate and consistent good son-in-law.

At this moment, the little maid whispered through the door curtain: "Madam, Mr. Yuan wants to see you."

Fei Zheng was startled for a moment, then turned to look at her daughter's sleeping face, which was slightly tired and sad. She couldn't help but laugh, lightly tapped her daughter's forehead, and said with a smile: "He came here quickly, it seems he really cares about you. My silly girl, you are still a little lucky to be silly."

Yuan Zhizhi knelt down and bowed to Fei Zheng in the main room.

Fei Zheng's expression was as calm as ever.Let him stand up and say: "The fact that you are here proves your sincerity. It's good if you have this heart."

Yuan Zhizhi listened respectfully. Like Fei Minglan, he realized belatedly that this woman who usually seemed weak and helpless might have clearer eyes than anyone else, and could clearly see all the worldly affairs and hypocrisy.

Thinking of this, Yuan Zhizhi felt a little scared, and at the same time he was glad that he had come right to ask for forgiveness. If he had come a step later and offended his mother-in-law, who was really secretive, the wife he got would probably fly away.

Now Yuan Zhizhi was shocked to realize that facing Fei Zheng was actually more stressful than facing Emperor Xuan Yu.

Then he suddenly realized, how could Fei Zhonggui, such a capable and talented businessman, be so obsessed with a really weak and incompetent beauty?Mrs. Fei Zheng must have some unique charm to allow him to love and protect her for many years.

I hope my wife won’t be as secretive as my mother-in-law.

Hara Zhizhi secretly wiped his cold sweat.

Fei Zheng glanced at him with a smile and said, "Lan'er is inside, go and see her."

Anyway, with her mother-in-law sitting outside, she is not afraid of the little son and daughter being embarrassed, not to mention they are such good and sensible children.

Yuan Zhizhi did not rush into the inner room, but said solemnly to Mrs. Fei Zheng: "Rong Xiang's matter is really not for me, but my son-in-law will handle it as soon as possible. My wife will not betray my daughter, let alone make her sad."

Fei Zheng nodded casually.

For this kind of thing, no matter how harsh the oath you make, no matter how beautiful the nice words you say, it's useless. Taking action is better than anything else.

At that time, it was regrettable that it was not until Fei Zhonggui married off his concubine that the thorn in Fei Zheng's heart was reluctantly removed.Otherwise, if you let that thorn dangle in front of your eyes, no matter how open-minded a woman is, she will inevitably have a strong heart and a bad temper.

Hara Haru raised the curtain and walked gently into the inner room.

It was already afternoon, and it was a bit cloudy outside. The light was slightly dim, but it highlighted Fei Minglan's delicate and slightly pale sleeping face.

She was lying sideways on the embroidered couch, with one hand on the side of her face and the other on her heart. It seemed that she was feeling faintly uncomfortable there, and there were still tears on her beautiful face as white as jade.

Hara Zhizhi's footsteps paused, and his heart felt like needles pricking him.

At this moment, he hated the tyranny and tyranny of the imperial power. Can the royal family trample and tease other people's feelings at will?With just one word from them, ordinary people can be plunged into dire straits.

Royal people can share grand plans and hegemony but cannot share trivial life.

When the world is unified, it's better to retreat early!Maybe he would live an easier and happier life together with his wife as a simple landowner and wealthy woman, guarding a few acres of orchid grass, right?

Yuan Zhizhi walked quietly to the embroidery couch, sat on the embroidery stool in front of the couch, gently held Fei Minglan's hand on his heart, and then placed it on his heart.

He quietly stared at Fei Minglan's sleeping face, looking at her face as delicate as a famous orchid, and felt that her originally restless heart miraculously calmed down.

He thought that he would be very happy to have such a woman who could calm his mind for the rest of his life, right?

Ever since he discovered his life experience and understood that he was a bastard, his inner struggle and pain have never stopped.

He did not feel inferior because he was born a concubine, but he was irritated by the grudges hidden behind the word "concubine".

Mrs. Tai was confident, Mrs. Zheng was aggrieved and resentful, and Bei Gu was at a loss. They each had their own positions, but weren't they the ones who caused the current situation?

Back then, as long as there was one person who had a firm stand, decisive and sophisticated methods, and solved the problem of the concubine and the concubine in advance, and the problem with the Queen Mother in the harem, how could the current situation happen?Even if he was never born because of this and couldn't see this extremely wonderful but equally cruel world, what does it matter?

The difference between a legitimate wife and a concubine, a legitimate son and a concubine, is not just the distinction between high and low in the literal sense, but also the struggle and entanglement for various interests in a deeper sense, which is what he hates.

No matter how kind or beautiful a person is, once they have negative emotions such as anger and hatred, they will gradually become ugly, right?No matter how deep the relationship is, it will become beyond recognition, right?

Did his father love his legitimate wife Zheng back then?Have you ever loved his biological mother Heyin?Even if he loved them all, who did he really cherish?Who did you love and protect?

Hara Zhiyuki is actually grateful to his aunt, and he also has brotherly feelings for his three eldest brothers, and he loves Yuan Pingyuki from the bottom of his heart. Although he was forced to leave Yuan Mansion in various ways, he will not alienate them in his heart, and he will use his own way to be filial to his parents and elders, and to be friendly to his brothers and sisters.

He was just tired of all the secretive things that happened early in the mansion.

Even now, several of his father's concubines still cause some trouble and unhappiness for his aunt-in-law from time to time, right?

As the saying goes, three women make a show. When there are too many women in the house, no matter how good the tutor is, all kinds of troubles will always arise.

Such a big house door made him impatient and depressed.

The original wife, Mrs. Zheng, was right. He wanted to break free from that luxurious cage, he wanted to spread his wings and soar into the blue sky, and he wanted to live the life he wanted to live.

He swore that he would rather not have a son or have an heir than give birth to a bastard like a ghost!

"Lan'er, in order for us to have a bowl of food to eat in the future, you have to work hard to have more sons." He raised Fei Minglan's hand to his, kissed it on his lips, and murmured.

Chapter 10(1)

On the ninth day of September, the Double Ninth Festival, Queen Xue Zhen of Jing State gave birth to Emperor Xuan Yu’s eldest son.

Xuan Yu was discussing things with Yuan Zhizhi in the imperial study. When he heard the eunuch coming to announce the good news, he frowned. Although the corners of his mouth were raised, the smile was not visible in his eyes.

He tapped the dragon case with his finger and asked, "How is the child doing?"

The eunuch who announced the good news was not as happy as he should have been. Instead, he kowtowed fearfully and said, "I took a look at you from a distance. Your Highness the Prince is a little thin and his cry is weak. However, Wenpo and the imperial doctor both said that except for a bit of congenital frailty, everything else is fine. He will be in good health if he is slowly nursed back to health."

Xuan Yu said "hmm".

[The impure description in this paragraph has been deleted, I am extremely sorry]

He felt that he was really unlucky. Why did he travel around for several months to contact wealthy businessmen for military supplies? After finally returning to the palace to report on his work, he happened to encounter this kind of "borrowed child" incident.

When there was news in the palace that Princess Leyang had become a monk, and Queen Xue discovered that she was more than two months pregnant, Yuan Zhizhi had already understood Xuanyu's arrangement - he wanted to turn the evil son born in Leyang into the queen's legitimate son!

Yuan Zhizhi felt sad for the poor Queen Xue. Han was her nominal first-born son. If it was a daughter, it would be okay. If it was a son, he would be the legitimate eldest son of the Jingguo royal family and the most likely candidate to be established as the prince to inherit the great cause in the future.

What if Queen Xue really gives birth to a son in the future?At the very least, he fell behind in terms of status and suffered a loss.

[The impure description in this paragraph has been deleted, I am extremely sorry]

This is ridiculous!

Although Xuan Yu has always liked beauty, he never strayed from the country for beauty. What happened this time?

But soon, another eunuch came to report the news. The little eunuch with a Chinese name was even more frightened, his face was as pale as paper, he knelt down and kowtowed: "Your Majesty, Your Highness Yuan Zhen... is so embarrassed."

Hara Harazhi's eyebrows jumped very quickly, and then he lowered his eyes and continued to be a wooden man.

Xuan Yu said "meet" and sat motionless on the dragon chair.

After a long time, he sighed almost inaudibly and murmured: "All things are impermanent. Life and death are inevitable. Life and death are reincarnations. Since she had already become a monk before her death, she should be buried quietly according to the rites of a princess without disturbing outsiders."
